name: @dxjs/seiva
description: The Seiva profile for the dxjs transport port: maps the Seiva error envelope to a structured SeivaError (field errors, scope/BOLA, optimistic concurrency) and turns command-bus events into @dxjs/query invalidation — over any adapter (remote or embedded).
